mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RANK ( ranking, flag, title, post_idx, view_count, like_count, unlike_count, comment_count ) VALUES ( #{ranking}, #{flag}, #{title}, #{postIdx}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{unlikeCount}, #{commentCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT idx, ranking, flag, title, post_idx as postIdx, view_count as viewCount, like_count as likeCount, unlike_count as unlikeCount, comment_count as commentCount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM TB_RANK WHERE flag = #{flag} ORDER BY ranking ASC
